title: GTA 6 and Zelda Lampooned on SNL as Ex-Nintendo Staff Recall Wario Skit
description: SNL lampoons the GTA 6 and Zelda showdown, while former Nintendo employees recall the controversial Elon Musk Wario sketch from years prior.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 and The Legend of Zelda Hit the SNL Stage

American comedy institution Saturday Night Live (SNL) has once again turned its satirical lens toward the gaming industry, airing a sketch that lampoons the November showdown between Grand Theft Auto 6 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. The humorous segment highlights the massive cultural footprint of both franchises, drawing laughs and discussions from gamers and mainstream audiences alike.

## A History of Nintendo and SNL Sketches

While the recent GTA 6 and Zelda parody brings lighthearted fun to the ongoing gaming discourse, it has also dredged up memories of past interactions between Nintendo and the long-running comedy show. In the wake of the latest broadcast, a pair of former Nintendo employees came forward to recall a much more infamous SNL sketch from years earlier—specifically, the one featuring Elon Musk portraying the iconic Nintendo character Wario. According to the former staffers, that particular sketch was decidedly not received well at Nintendo during the time.

## The Pop Culture Weight of GTA 6

As GTA 6 continues to dominate conversations across the entertainment landscape, seeing it referenced in mainstream sketches like SNL underscores just how deeply embedded video games are in modern pop culture. Industry observers note that as anticipation builds toward upcoming release windows, parodies and cultural references of this scale will likely become even more common.

## Editor's Take

It is always fascinating to see gaming phenomena bleed into mainstream sketch comedy like SNL. While the reception to Nintendo-related skits has historically been mixed internally—as recalled by former employees regarding past controversies—the inclusion of GTA 6 proves the franchise is already a titan of global entertainment culture well ahead of its launch.
